_doc: Amendment 8 (coordinator decision 11-09 ~19:00 CST after full r1: +1-3 pp member effects are below single-round A7 power). Written and committed BEFORE use; effective at the r2/r3 round boundary of p1109c_full (driver stopped between rounds with gpu stop, resumed from state.json). Flags: c1109 a8, carry_cap, carry_seed. Kept OUTSIDE harness/frozen: the frozen tree's sha is the run's anchor (state anchor_sha, checked at every round's proposals), so amendment 8 is recorded here, in the run's prereg.json (a8 block) and in BUILD_STATUS; harness/frozen/prereg_1109c.json is unchanged.
carry: a stage-2 candidate on the member track (A7) that is not admitted, with mean D > 0 and rows up > down, is carried; at most carry_cap = 4 carried at once (higher D first; beyond the cap logged, not carried). Off-scope-abstaining gate writes (pool path) are not carried. Seed: r1s11_576f71 (r1, D +.042, 19/10, p .033) and any r2 candidate that meets the same rule under A7 (r2 was judged before A8 took effect).
read: each later round the carried candidate and its parent answer fresh draws CARRY_D0 + 2r and CARRY_D0 + 2r + 1 (CARRY_D0 = 1000; same engine seeds for both: paired; never reused), 4 vs 4 samples on this round's R rows (score minus the stage-1 draw, plus SELECT, lineage cards removed; scope rows if scoped). The read that selected it is not a bet.
eprocess: betting e-process eproc.eprocess_rows: one bet per picture cluster per read (cluster mean paired D, clipped to [-1, 1], sorted cluster key), E = prod (1 + lambda d), lambda predictable (sum d / sum d^2 of earlier bets, clipped [0, .6], first .2). Valid under H0: no cluster's expected paired gain is positive (fresh seeds every read); Ville: P(sup E >= 1/a) <= a.
multiplicity: e-Bonferroni over the fixed carry cap K = 4: admit iff E >= K / alpha = 80 (alpha .05). Family-wise error over the carried set <= .05 at any time (sum over <= 4 concurrent e-processes of P(sup E >= 80) <= 4 x .0125). Carried candidates are not in the round's A7 Holm family.
admit: E >= 80 AND fixed guards on the accumulated fresh rows: no-harm (sum of harm <= sum of the parent-redraw bounds, harm_threshold per read), accumulated mean D > 0 (unseen rows; card_vs_unseen), rows up > down, critic (passed at proposal), fired-z >= 1.96 if scoped (z = sum D / sqrt(sum D^2) over accumulated rows), RRSI cost rule gain branch with dS = accumulated mean D.
drop: D <= 0 on two consecutive reads, or 4 reads without admission, or parent gone / rebuild failed. Tripwire (A6') and the C2 freeze apply to carried admits as to any admit.
checks: c1109deploy/a8_tests.py (CPU, 96-row cal 7 draws): N1 real null e-paths; N2 parametric null + power from the real per-row stock accuracy (16 samples per row) and real clusters, 4 reads, drop rule; numbers in result_a8.
unchanged: A7 member track per round, Holm over <= 3 stage-2 candidates, A1/A2/A3/A5/null_ref, rows 96, all thresholds

result_a8.N2_note: 2000 lineages per cell, real per-row stock accuracy (396 rows, 384 picture clusters, mean .609), persistent fix on rows the parent mostly misses, drop rule on; size per lineage <= .0025 vs the e-Bonferroni share .0125
result_a8.carry_rows: all score + SELECT rows (396 at 96/bench), lineage cards removed; a carried candidate is not ranked on the stage-1 draw
